title: Professional Email Seat Limits and Entry Requirements
content:
Every Professional Email product is sold per seat, within the seat limits below.

| Product | Fewest seats per subscription | Most seats per subscription | Lowest seat count a reduction may reach | Live subscriptions per email domain |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Mail Starter | 1 | 500 | 1 | 1 |
| Harborline Mail Plus | 1 | 500 | 1 | 1 |
| Harborline Mail Pro | 1 | 500 | 1 | 1 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 1 | 300 | 1 | 1 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 1 | 300 | 1 | 1 |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 1 | 300 | 1 | 1 |

## Entry requirements

- Every Professional Email product requires a custom domain for the mailboxes.
- Every Microsoft 365 Business product additionally requires that the Microsoft Customer Agreement has been accepted.
- The most seats a subscription may hold are 500 on each Harborline Mail product and 300 on each Microsoft 365 Business product.

## Points of judgement

- **Can a Harborline Mail Plus subscription be ordered with 420 seats?** Yes: 420 lies between 1 and 500.
- **Can a Microsoft 365 Business Basic subscription be ordered with 420 seats?** No: the most a Microsoft 365 Business product allows is 300.
- **Can a seat reduction take a subscription to zero seats?** No: on every product the lowest count a reduction may reach is 1 seat.
- Only one live subscription is allowed per email domain on every product.
